newsitem.title: USA: Signature Inns completes preferred offering.
newsitem.headline: Signature Inns completes preferred offering.

text.p: Signature Inns Inc said Tuesday it has completed a $40 million offering of preferred stock.

The offering represents the sale of two million shares of convertible preferred stock at a price of $20 per share, the hotel operater said, adding that the company intends to use the net proceeds of about $36.1 million from the offering to acquire full ownership of all of the operating Signature Inn hotels which are now owned by various partnerships in which the company is the general partner.
The settlement date of the sale is expected to be January 24, 1997.
Once the offering is effective, the company's previously declared 1-for-3.7 per share reverse split of its common stock also became effective, the company said.
Signature shares were unchanged at 8-1/8 Tuesday.
